courier-relay/provider-protocols: Courier Relay provider protocol agreements for count and summary. Applies to all complete, independent receipt sets. Omitted protocol selects current protocol "2"; explicit "1" and "2" remain supported and responses report the actual protocol. Protocol 1 identifies a delivery by (account_id, delivery_id), accepts the earliest occurred_at UTC instant, and breaks equal-instant ties with the smallest record_id. Protocol 2 identifies a delivery by delivery_id alone across all accounts, accepts the latest occurred_at UTC instant, and breaks equal-instant ties with the smallest record_id. In both versions exactly one receipt is accepted per identity; all others are duplicates. Accepted receipts retain every original field, timestamp spelling, and payload, and are presented in original input order. Offset timestamps are compared as UTC instants, including across date boundaries; record IDs use Unicode code-point order. The agreement applies regardless of receipt dates. Empty sets count zero accepted and zero duplicates; one receipt counts one accepted and zero duplicates. Count and summary responses contain exactly protocol, accepted_count, and duplicate_count. Approval source for protocol 2 and making it current: Beads issue trial-fy9. Source for retained protocol 1: vendor/protocol-1.md and the explicit backward-compatibility requirement in trial-fy9. Verified on 2026-09-07 with 12 unit tests, all supplied count_1, summary_1, and summary_2 public cases, plus direct cross-date-offset, equal-instant tie, unsupported-protocol, and unknown-command checks.
